title: Quick portrait sketches
content: Sitting around a breakfast table with other artists is a golden opportunity to practice quick portrait sketches. Here'sKen Laager, drawn with water soluble colored pencils and some watercolor.In addition to Ken, I was joined byChad Smith(far left),Garin BakerandGreg Shea(not visible),Richard Scarpa, and my wife Jeanette.Marc Holmes, a leader in theUrban Sketchersmovement from Montreal, also joined us on our trip last week to Massachusetts. I sketched him using black and red-brown watercolor pencils with a little watercolor in the background.Here's my expedition kit for water media, with casein and gouache in the bags, two watercolor pan sets, a box of pencils, my homemade pochade rig in the upper left, and assorted tripods and camera gear, which I used in theHiggins Armory Museum video.
